\begin{tablenotes}\footnotesize
\item 2,560 GRPO training completions; 1,252 in the 81 groups with both correct and wrong ones and every view scored. Judge prompt: neutral system prompt and the bare puzzle; scores the solution, ``Answer: \ldots'' and the end-of-turn token. Policy prompt: the GRPO prompt (puzzle and format instructions); scores the whole completion, reasoning included. SFT policy: GRPO's starting point; base model: Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct. \texttt{mean} / \texttt{sum}: mean / total token log-probability of the scored tokens; \texttt{low10}: sum of the 10 lowest token log-probabilities in the scored span; SC: self-certainty \citep{kang_scalable_2025}, used as an RL reward by \citet{zhao_learning_2026}, the mean over scored positions of the KL divergence from the uniform distribution to the model's next-token distribution. Regression: linear probability model of correct (0/1) on the signal, standardized within its group, with group fixed effects and the log number of scored tokens as a control. Standard errors clustered by group in parentheses. $^{*}p<0.1$, $^{**}p<0.05$, $^{***}p<0.01$.
\end{tablenotes}
